summary:
Adobe’s red “A” is the tab icon on adobe.com. Creative Cloud apps such as Photoshop have their own icons, so this page does not swap in an app icon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against adobe.com. HTML came from https://www.adobe.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.adobe.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 2228 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ee1100 comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-48x48-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-48x48-01.png at 48×48 (png, 1040 bytes) from https://www.adobe.com/favicon.ico.
